## Frequently asked questions

### Where is RKC Mahal?
No. 4 & 5, Ramakrishna Nagar Main Road, Porur, Chennai 600 116.

### What facilities does RKC Mahal have?
Centralized A/C hall, Spacious dining hall, Furnished A/C rooms, Fully equipped kitchen, Car parking, 24/7 generator backup, Weddings & muhurthams, Betrothals, Receptions.

### Is the hall air-conditioned?
Yes. The hall is centrally air-conditioned, and the rooms are A/C too.

### What if the power goes?
Power is guaranteed 24/7 with a full-capacity generator backup.

### How do I book RKC Mahal?
Pick your date in the booking section of this page and send it on WhatsApp, or call +91 70920 81816. Booking is confirmed on full payment, first come, first served.
